locations.note: Hans Capon, Henry and their escort set out from Rattay for Trosky with a letter for Otto von Bergow.
The first of the two maps: the sandstone rocks, villages and castles of the Bohemian Paradise around Trosky.
Otto von Bergow's castle on its twin rock towers, where Henry and Capon question his loyalty to Sigismund.
Kuttenberg, the silver-mining city, the second-largest in Bohemia, recreated as it was in 1403.
At Suchdol Margrave Jobst warns Henry's group off banditry, having made a truce with Sigismund.

routes.name: Henry and Capon
routes.note: From Rattay to Trosky, then south to Kuttenberg and Suchdol.
